concept: Blue/White Maid Lucario V41 — bonnet-only macroform pass 3

designIntent.firstRead: A soft white maid bonnet wrapping the rear crown in one connected ruffled arc. No other clothing in this pass.
macroRules: Preserve all 87 official Lucario bones and geometry exactly.
Keep the face and forehead open.
Wrap behind the ear roots instead of sitting on the forehead.
The silhouette must read as one continuous cloth arc, not two flowers and not a flat stripe.
No armor, crown, cage, plate stack or rectangular cap.
Use alpha-masked zero-thickness Bedrock planes only in this compatibility preview.
Use overlap and alternating angles to imply cloth curvature.
The three-quarter view is the hero read; front stays subordinate; rear clearly shows the complete bonnet.
Do not add dress, apron, sleeves, bow or torso clothing before owner approval.
referenceTechniqueCarryover: Separate the structural cap surface from its decorative ruffle edge.
Build a curved read from a small number of overlapping oriented surfaces, not a staircase of cuboids.
Keep the bonnet anatomy-following and animation-parented to head_angle.
designIntent.iterationNote: Pass 2 increased visibility but still read as side flowers in three-quarter view and a horizontal stripe from the rear. Pass 3 replaces that layout with a continuous rear-crown fan: broad rear-left/rear-center/rear-right cap panels, larger ear-root wings, two shallow top cloth panels, and a three-segment lower scalloped ruffle. This is still preview geometry, not owner-approved production art.
